snippet.title: UltraDeep! - Ultra-Addictive iPhone Doodle Game from Viqua Games
snippet.description:
Get it now!  http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/ultradeep/id379397835?mt=8

Follow us on twitter!: http://twitter.com/viquagames

UltraDeep! is an extremely addictive doodle style iPhone game coming soon from Viqua Games!

Guide the doodle guy by tilting your iPhone. Pickup diamonds to charge up your superpower and when it's ready, tap to use it to smash through obstacles!

Multiple power ups and upgrades await. See how deep you can go!

Screenshots available at:
http://iphone.viquagames.com/games/ultra-deep/

Follow the latest Viqua Games news:
http://www.viquagames.com
